subject: Renewal health review + proposed scale pilot for next term
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@fluxlytics.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@fluxlytics.ai>
Date: 2027-07-01T15:22:00Z
Subject: Q2 usage and renewal window — can we review?

Hey Maya,

Thanks for the ongoing support during our ramp. Attached is a condensed usage export for May and a short set of latency traces. High-level notes from our side: 
- Token consumption is +48% month-over-month driven by an expanded reranking job and new nightly summarization pipeline.
- 90th percentile latency spikes during batch windows (15:00-17:00 PT) up to ~1.2s for generation endpoints; embeddings stable.
- Cost per 1k tokens is higher than expected after we rolled the higher-temperature multi-turn experiments.

Our contract comes up in mid-August — we wanted to start the renewal conversation early. We have three asks:
1) Can Redwood help model a 12-month committed capacity that covers projected growth (+60% over next 12 months) with predictable unit pricing?
2) Any recommendations on quantization or batching changes to reduce cost without losing QA for reranking?
3) Can we trial a 6-week dedicated pilot for the rerank pipeline (to guarantee tail latency)?

Attaching: fluxlytics-may-usage-summary.csv, latency-sample-traces.zip.

Appreciate a quick sync — Tom and I are available next week Tue/Wed afternoons PT.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of ML Infrastructure, Fluxlytics
From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@fluxlytics.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-02T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Q2 usage and renewal window — can we review?

Elena — thanks for the export, that was helpful. Quick read-through and proposed next steps below.

Summary observations (initial):
- The +48% MoM looks concentrated to two routes: /generate-chat-rerank and /batch-summarize. Rerank is ~62% of token spend.
- Tail latency correlated with peak concurrent batch windows; likely a batching / scheduling pressure point rather than model size.
- We can get 20–35% token-cost reduction from: 
  * enabling 8-bit quantization on the rerank model (we've validated negligible quality delta for rerank in similar workloads),
  * switching to continuous batching with smaller max-batch windows during the 15:00-17:00 PT window,
  * prefix caching for nightly summarization where applicable.

Proposal (what Redwood can do quickly):
1) Run a 6-week Dedicated pilot for the rerank route — we can provision a small dedicated GPU pool, instrument the KV cache, and set a latency SLO (p95 < 350ms) for the route.
2) Prepare a modeled 12-month committed-offer that takes an additional +60% commit but staggers invoices (quarterly) and includes a 10% unit-rate discount and one-time pilot-credit.
3) We'll produce a short ROI workbook showing break-even for quantization + dedicated pilot (expected payback < 9 weeks at current usage trajectory).

Next steps:
- I can run the ROI model and SOW draft with Karthik and Sean. If Tue/Wed afternoon PT next week works, propose Wed 2027-07-07 14:00 PT for a 30m sync.
- Can you share any evaluation prompts/metrics you use to assess rerank QA so we can validate quantization safely?

Looping in Karthik (pricing / contracts) and Sean (Dedicated pilot / infra ops).

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Park <elena@fluxlytics.ai>, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-03T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Q2 usage and renewal window — cost model + pilot SOW draft

Elena / team — quick price sketch from my side to prepare for Wed: 

Assumptions (from Maya's read + your May export):
- Current run-rate: ~1.2B tokens/month (May peak).
- Rerank route = 62% of tokens, summarization = 20%, other = 18%.
- Projected growth = +60% over 12 months (conservative).

Committed offer (12 months) — proposal:
- Commit: 1.9B tokens/month (rolls up to ~22.8B tokens/year) — this is ~60% uplift over current run-rate.
- Unit price: $0.85 per 1k tokens (10% discount vs public hosted list for that profile).
- Pilot credit: $18k (applied to first invoice) for a 6-week Dedicated pilot (capped infra hours).
- SLA: latency SLO inclusion for pinned rerank route; 99.9% uptime and p95 soft-target documented in SOW.

Estimated savings (back-of-envelope):
- If we enable 8-bit quantization on the rerank route, conservative token-cost reduction = 25% for that route => net cost drop ~15% company-wide.
- Combined with commit discount and pilot credit, Fluxlytics should see ~22–28% blended TCO reduction in year-1 vs continuing on public hosted consumption at current mix.

I attached a draft SOW and quick ROI workbook (pilot-sow-draft.pdf). Sean, can you confirm infra ops can provision the pilot for 2027-07-12 start date (6 weeks)?

Elena — if this looks directionally good I can produce a formal quote and a DocuSign envelope for the commitment.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Pricing, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena@fluxlytics.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@fluxlytics.ai>
Date: 2027-07-06T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Q2 usage and renewal window — can we review?

Thanks all — this is very helpful and the numbers look promising. A few clarifications before we lock dates: 

- The 1.9B/month commit aligns with our internal forecast if we roll the scheduled rerank increase in Q3. Good.
- For quantization QA: we use NDCG@10 on the rerank holdout (sample set attached) and synthetic adversarial prompts — can Redwood run the quantized validation against our NDCG score and share run artifacts?
- Pilot timing: 2027-07-12 start works for us; team will need access to a staging endpoint and an ops channel with a 4-hour incident SLA during pilot windows.
- Contract: please include a clause for a one-time right to review unit pricing at month 7 if our token mix materially changes (defined as >20% rerank share delta).

Tom and I are good to move forward on the SOW + DocuSign once you confirm the incident SLA and the quantization validation plan.

Elena
Elena Park
Head of ML Infrastructure, Fluxlytics
